request: Advanced-route deliverable: wildfire staging-resource gap. Pull active US wildfire incidents from NIFC/WFIGS (ActiveFireCandidate=1). Enrich with EOC metrics (size class, growth rate, days-since-discovery). Surface F2 assigned-resource fields (TotalIncidentPersonnel, EstimatedCostToDate, IncidentComplexityLevel) explicitly so gap ratios are one-hop in Tableau. Publish two DSes to Tableau Cloud under Prep Agent. Grid-spillover join to US Grid Network is a dashboard-time step, not a build-time join.

sources.name: WFIGS US Wildfire Incidents (Staging Gap view)
sources.description: NIFC/WFIGS Current Incident Locations FeatureServer (ActiveFireCandidate=1). One row per active wildfire incident with geometry (point) and IRWIN attributes. Personnel and cost fields are IMT self-reported.

args.name: Staging Gap Trend
args.features_description: Per-incident active wildfires with EOC size/growth/staleness enrichment plus explicit staging-gap fields: TotalIncidentPersonnel, EstimatedCostToDate, IncidentComplexityLevel, jurisdictional agency + protecting agency. Compute personnel_per_100acres = TotalIncidentPersonnel / (IncidentSize/100), cost_per_acre = EstimatedCostToDate / IncidentSize in Tableau.
args.stats_description: Long-form per-(state, complexity, agency) statistics on discovery volume with 30d rolling counts and z-score anomalies. Use to spot regional surges.

outputs.name: Wildfire Staging Gap Detail
outputs.description:
Row-level active US wildfire incidents from NIFC/WFIGS (ActiveFireCandidate=1) enriched for staging-resource gap analysis. Each row includes IncidentName, IncidentSize (acres), PercentContained, days_since_discovery, size_class, containment_band, acres_per_day, POOState/County/City, POOJurisdictionalAgency + POOProtectingAgency, POOLandownerCategory, TotalIncidentPersonnel, EstimatedCostToDate, IncidentComplexityLevel, geometry (point), plus temporal calendar axes. Source: NIFC/WFIGS. Refresh: hourly.

Advanced-route notes: staging gap is a HEURISTIC proxy — real staging goes through ICS resource orders. F2 personnel + cost are IMT self-reported and lag by one shift. Use in Tableau by: (a) computing personnel_per_100acres and cost_per_acre; (b) flagging incidents where the ratio is below a complexity-adjusted threshold; (c) joining to 'US Grid Network' on POOState for grid-load spillover; (d) flagging POOJurisdictionalAgency != POOProtectingAgency for multi-jurisdiction friction.

outputs.name: Wildfire Staging Gap Stats
outputs.description: Long-form per-(state, complexity, agency) discovery statistics for active wildfires: monthly counts, 30-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True). Use to identify states / agencies with unusual clustering that would strain staging.
